page_data.en:
H.T. KAEGEL, Mme KRASSOPKIVA AND GEORGE STEFENHOVER
ACTIVITIES OF.

H.T. KAEGEL.
Nothing is known of this individual. He is not
registered with the local U.S. Consulate-General.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police Records
concerning him.
Further report will be submitted as soon as information
is received regarding him.

MME. KRASSOPKIVA.
Maria Stepanovna Krassopkova, Russian widow, was born on
February 5th, 1903 in Ufa, Russia. She arrived in Shanghai
from Tientsin in 1934.
Her daughter, Mary Hoffman, British by marriage, is
employed as a Secretary by Mr. F.I. Kouzmin, Russian,
proprietor of the Compagnie Universelle, Import & Export
Office at the Amherst Building, 360 Szechuen Road.
Mrs Krassopkova is the mistress of Mr. G.L. Gilbert,
British, Deputy Commissioner, Chinese Maritime Customs,
Shanghai Office.
She is not known to be interested in politics, is not a
member of any political Party and is not connected with
Japanese Military.

GEORGE STEFENHOVER.
G. Stefanhover, a German, aged 39 years. Is an honest
Jew and member of the Local Nazi Party. He is a salesman
page_data.zh:
H.T. KAEGEL、KRASSOPKIVA 夫人及 GEORGE STEFENHOVER
之活动。

H.T. KAEGEL。
对此人一无所知。他未在美国驻上海总领事馆登记。
工部局警务处档案中亦无关于他的记录。
一旦收到有关此人的信息，将立即提交进一步报告。

KRASSOPKIVA 夫人。
Maria Stepanovna Krassopkova，俄罗斯籍寡妇，1903年2月5日出生于俄罗斯乌法。她于1934年从天津抵达上海。
其女 Mary Hoffman，因婚姻取得英国国籍，受雇于俄罗斯人 F.I. Kouzmin 先生，担任秘书。Kouzmin 先生是位于四川路360号阿美士德大楼（Amherst Building）的“环球进出口公司”（Compagnie Universelle, Import & Export Office）的业主。
Krassopkova 夫人是英国人 G.L. Gilbert 先生的情妇。Gilbert 先生任中国海关上海办事处副税务司。
据知她对政治不感兴趣，并非任何政党成员，也与日本军方无关联。

GEORGE STEFENHOVER。
G. Stefanhover，德国人，39岁。是一名正直的犹太人，也是当地纳粹党党员。他是一名推销员

page_data.en:
by profession and was lately employed by Kielhoff & Co,
a German Firm at 20 Canton Road. He has been living in
Shanghai for the last 10 years.
He was connected with one Martin LIEGMULLER, a German
and important member of the Gestapo and Special Courier
of the local German Consulate-General, in whose company
he had left Shanghai for Germany, via Siberia, on June
14th, 1940 by the s.s. " Koto Maru ", presumably on some
important mission and is expected to Shanghai at the
end of this year.
page_data.zh:
为业，最近受雇于广东路20号的德国商号 Kielhoff & Co。他在上海已居住十年。
他曾与一名叫 Martin LIEGMULLER 的德国人有往来，此人是盖世太保的重要成员，也是德国驻上海总领事馆的特别信使。1940年6月14日，他与 Liegmuller 一同乘坐“光岛丸”号（s.s. "Koto Maru"）经西伯利亚离开上海前往德国，推测是执行某种重要任务，预计将于今年年底返回上海。

page_data.en:
SECRET
June 22nd, 1940.

Can it be confirmed that the occupier of 714
Broadway Mansions is an individual going by the name
of H.T. KAEGER who is alleged to hold an American
passport? If so any information available about this
man, his activities and connections in Shanghai, will
be of great assistance.

Information is also requested regarding a certain
Mme. KRASNOPEEVA, Room 906 Broadway Mansions. Any
indications that she is connected with the Japanese
Military would be of interest.

Is there any trace of a certain GEORGE STIEFENHOFER
believed to have been employed at one time by GLATHE &
WITT and recently by RICKHOFF, 20 Canton Road. If he
can be traced can it be ascertained whether he intends
to leave Shanghai in the near future?

机密
1940年6月22日。

能否确认百老汇大厦714室的住户是一名自称 H.T. KAEGER 的人，据称其持有美国护照？若是如此，任何关于此人在上海的活动及关系的现有信息，都将大有裨益。

另请提供关于百老汇大厦906室某位 KRASNOPEEVA 夫人的信息。若有任何迹象表明她与日本军方有关联，均值得关注。

是否有名为 GEORGE STIEFENHOFER 者的踪迹？据信此人曾一度受雇于 GLATHE & WITT，最近则受雇于广东路20号的 RICKHOFF。若能找到其踪迹，能否查明他是否打算在近期离开上海？
